title: Brought into the King's Chamber by Timothy Hogan
summary: Jay Anderson tells of Brought into the King's Chamber by Timothy Hogan, about 2020s at King's Chamber, Great Pyramid, Giza, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote:
I went I was I was brought into the
King's Chamber by him personally.

plain: A man named Jay Anderson told a podcast host, Jesse Michels, that sometime in the 2020s he was taken into the King's Chamber, a room deep inside the Great Pyramid of Giza in Egypt. He says a man named Timothy Hogan brought him in personally, and he tells it as a sign of the special access and connections he had.
